title: Prepare a one-page brief before the clinician walks in. (success)
story: Reference run: right tools, answer fully supported by what was read.
description: Read medications and recent labs together, then write one brief. Add no value that was in neither source.
expected_reference: Ines Kato (pat_00001). Medications: apixaban 20 mg PO daily for AF, levothyroxine 125 mcg daily, metoprolol succinate 50 mg daily. Allergy: sulfa. Labs from 2024-05-17: TSH 0.2 mIU/L (low) and free T4 1.9 ng/dL (high) while on levothyroxine. Creatinine 1.1, Hgb 12.4 and platelets 231 are all normal. Worth reviewing are the thyroid results in the context of the levothyroxine dose and the recorded apixaban dose.
